messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — streaming.slo breach detected for inference-hosted-prod (us-east1)
incident-bot: metrics: p95=1200ms p99=4200ms error_rate=0.8% stream_drop=1.2%
incident-bot: spike start 6578123420 -> now. Affected model variants: rwd-13b-q4_0 / rwd-7b-q4_0
Alex R: ack, I'm oncall. paging infra and hw. beginning triage. :eyes:
Priya K: noticed customer tickets for slow chat responses in dashboards. cc @Emily S for CS
Jamal M: quick telemetry: streaming stalls correlate with long KV fetch times and backend stall RT ~3.8s. pulling GPU node health.
infra-bot: node-summary: host-ue1-03 (gpu-3) high GPU power/thermal. ECC correctable count rising.
Alex R: running nvidia-smi on host-ue1-03
Alex R:
```
Timestamp: 2026-03-15T12:34:50Z
GPU 2: Util 86% Temp 88C ECC_Corr 56 ECC_Uncorr 0 Power 320W
GPU 3: Util 92% Temp 91C ECC_Corr 124 ECC_Uncorr 1
``` 
Sasha L: GPU3 showing ECC correctable spikes and one correctable->uncorrectable flip. could be flaky card. This would explain KV cache thrash + stalls.
Emily S: customers affected: 3 enterprise tenants reporting >10% session degradation. CS already DMing affected accounts with incident link.
Jamal M: logs from inference-runtime show repeated kernel timeouts -> streaming stall & p99 tail.
Jamal M:
```
[2026-03-15T12:33:12Z] worker: stall detected: kv-fetch wait 3800ms
[2026-03-15T12:33:13Z] backend: gpu-kernel-timeout 12000us
[2026-03-15T12:33:14Z] scheduler: drop=0.0124
```
Priya K: impact estimate: ~1.3k reqs/min in us-east1, sustained for 8m. projected SLO burn if not mitigated.
Alex R: mitigation options: 1) drain host-ue1-03 and failover requests to us-east2/dedicated pool 2) apply auto-fallback to rwd-7b-optimized for streaming 3) throttle batch size to reduce kernel pressure
Sasha L: recommend immediate: set routing weight -> fallback pool at 40% and start drain on host-ue1-03. I'll kick off thermal check and hw ticket.
Alex R: executing routing change
infra-bot: route-policy change: streaming.us-east1 weight(rwd-13b-prod->fallback)=40% by Alex R
Jamal M: starting graceful drain: cordon host-ue1-03, migrate active KV sessions
Alex R:
```
kubectl cordon node/host-ue1-03
kubectl drain node/host-ue1-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
``` 
Priya K: monitoring customer latency and error graphs. p99 dropping from 4200ms -> 800ms within 90s of route change :party_parrot:
Emily S: CS update sent: 'We're seeing elevated latency in us-east1; mitigation underway; no data loss; will update in 30m.' 
Sasha L: hw ticket opened: TICKET-88932, type: suspect GPU module, requested RMA. noted ECC trends and thermal profile.
Alex R: next steps: continue draining, confirm streaming metrics stable, if not restore extra capacity from dedicated pool. also capture GPU kernel logs and grep for ECC errors.
Jamal M: capturing kv cache stats — eviction rate spiked ~x6 during incident window. suggest follow-up on cache sizing and per-session limits.
infra-bot: drain complete: host-ue1-03 drained at 6578123680. No active sessions remaining.
Alex R: rebooting inference service on host-ue1-03 to clear driver state before RMA handoff.
Alex R:
```
sudo systemctl restart inference-runtime
journalctl -u inference-runtime -n 200 | tail -n 50
``` 
Sasha L: hw confirmed single correctable->uncorrectable transition, prefer replace. scheduling pickup tomorrow AM.
Priya K: customer impact summary for postmortem: 8m elevated p99, ~1.2-1.4k reqs/min affected, ~3 enterprise tenants reported session slowdowns, no errors persisted after reroute.
Emily S: will open incident ticket for CS with templated update and list of customers notified.
Alex R: handing off to next oncall @ 6578127056 (in ~1h). adding runbook notes: drain, route-fallback, hw-ticket, capture logs.
Jamal M: adding follow-up items: add automated detection for ECC correctable delta >50 in 5m -> auto-evacuate node; tune KV cache eviction thresholds.
Emily S: thanks team. filing postmortem draft and linking telemetry. will schedule blameless review.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: created 6578123456-evacuate-gpu-thermal-ecc
incident-bot: status: mitigated (routing,fallback,drain). postmortem: pending
Alex R: closing thread for now, will reopen if regressions seen. :thumbsup:
